what: Edit seeds are never taken in production: crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit.rs `seed` calls EditionedFileId::seed_parse after `lowered.refresh(lower())` has written the new texts, but every write ends with hir-def nameres maintainer (order 100, crates/hir-def/src/nameres/delta.rs), which parses the written files; salsa keeps that parse, so Reparse::keep refuses every seed and `retain` silently drops them (a fallback to a whole parse; no-fallback). Seed inside the write: hand the seeds to the refresh so it calls seed_parse within the same Db::batch, after set_file_text and before the batch ends (as crates/blaze-intent/src/tests/rename.rs `check` now does), and make a refused seed an error naming the file rather than a silent drop.
